rows.responsibility: Windows console-lock precondition and diagnostic gate for professional desktop tests: classify locked/unlocked/unknown without treating platform/precondition failures as product outcomes.
rows.upstream_owner: tdesktop task-test harness / Windows platform precondition reader
rows.state_machine: resolve process session -> query active console/session info -> validate WTSINFOEX level/bytes -> classify lock state or unknown -> emit privacy-safe diagnostics -> gate only when positively locked
rows.side_effects: Test-only OS session metadata read; no product mutation, no clipboard/content capture, no credential access.
rows.failure_cases: ProcessIdToSessionId failure; WTSQuerySessionInformationW failure; short/invalid WTSINFOEX; unexpected level/flags; documented Windows 7/Server 2008 R2 reversed lock flags; no Windows platform.
rows.ui_disposition: TEST/EVIDENCE ONLY. No Telegram-derived production UI. Reuse Fabushi professional test/evidence harness.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: Canonical cross-platform desktop test precondition/privacy evidence harness
rows.platform_differences: Windows uses WTS session metadata. Older Windows versions with reversed documented flags must remain unknown/fail-safe. Non-Windows is explicit not-applicable and must not fire a false lock gate.
rows.production_evidence: Exact accepted blob read; equivalent Fabushi test-harness implementation/evidence remains open.
rows.test_evidence: Windows locked/unlocked/unknown fixtures; malformed/short response; unsupported legacy Windows; non-Windows N/A; diagnostics must contain metadata/reason only and no user content.
rows.reachability_status: accepted-tree exact blob responsibility proven; professional test-harness closure open
rows.notes: Reading closes no unknown. Positive locked state may block a test action; unknown is diagnostic and must not be silently promoted to unlocked.
